stem: Why does the author include this idea?
instruction:
Read this quotation from paragraph 9.

You'd be surprised at the places where these stories crop up. In Silicon Valley, for instance, a family of foxes decided to make a home on the Facebook campus in Menlo Park along with 2,500 employees, and Mark Zuckerberg himself took an interest in the skulk.

options.label: A
options.text: To emphasize that wildlife living in urban areas is more common than people think

options.label: B
options.text: To compare the wildlife found in different regions of California

options.label: C
options.text: To describe Mark Zuckerberg's disapproval of the foxes living on the Facebook campus

options.label: D
options.text: To question whether the foxes are safe living in Menlo Park
